hints.title: Collision Detection
hints.text: Record all previously assigned file names in a lookup structure.

hints.title: Tracking Next Suffix
hints.text: Maintain the smallest untried integer suffix k for each base name to avoid scanning from 1 repeatedly.

hints.title: Candidate Search
hints.text: While the formed candidate name with suffix exists in the map, increment k. Then update both the base name and candidate name in the map.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Scanning k from 1 for every collision leads to O(N^2) quadratic string comparisons.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Storing the last used integer k per base name amortizes candidate search to O(N).
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate realizes that candidate name itself must be registered in the map and suffix counter must advance monotonically.
complexity.notes: Amortized linear time across all queries.

solutions.approach: Hash map tracking last used suffix counter amortizing lookup
